description: This file contains selectors for scheduled posts in the Mattermost Redux state, including functions to retrieve scheduled posts by team, count, error status, and feature toggle based on configuration and license.

methods.name: makeGetScheduledPostsByTeam
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve scheduled posts for a specific team, optionally including direct channels, sorted by scheduled time.

methods.name: getScheduledPostsByTeamCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of scheduled posts for a team, including direct channels if specified.

methods.name: hasScheduledPostError
methods.description: Checks if there are any errors related to scheduled posts for a specific team.

methods.name: showChannelOrThreadScheduledPostIndicator
methods.description: Provides data on scheduled posts for a channel or thread, including count and optionally the scheduled post if only one is present.

methods.name: isScheduledPostsEnabled
methods.description: Selector that determines if scheduled posts feature is enabled based on configuration and license.
